sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of 'Traditional Mahjong' lies its core gameplay mechanics, which are both simple and complex at the same time. The objective of the game is to clear the board by matching tiles in pairs or sets, with the game ending when all the tiles have been removed. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as straightforward as it seems. As you progress through the levels, the tiles will be shuffled and rearranged, making it increasingly difficult to find matching pairs. This is where strategy comes into play, as you'll need to think carefully about which tiles to remove and when.

The game features a variety of tile combinations, including suits, honors, and bamboos, each with its unique characteristics and challenges. As you match tiles, you'll earn points, which will help you unlock new levels and achievements. But be warned, the game also features obstacles, such as blocked tiles and time limits, which will test your skills and patience.

One of the key aspects of 'Traditional Mahjong' is its tile-swapping mechanic, which allows you to swap tiles to create pairs or sets. This mechanic is both simple and complex, as you'll need to think carefully about which tiles to swap and when. With the ability to swap tiles in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions, you'll have to use your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills to clear the board.

The game also features a zooming mechanic, which allows you to zoom in and out of the playing field to get a better view of the tiles. This mechanic is especially useful in the later levels, where the tiles will be shuffled and rearranged, making it difficult to see which tiles are paired or not. By zooming in and out, you'll be able to spot matching tiles more easily and make informed decisions about which tiles to remove.
